subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu DM continuity be fixed by changing the default/account scoping, adding Feishu-specific malformed open_id validation and doctor repair, changing direct-DM maintenance retention, or splitting those into separate repairs?
rationale: Current source confirms plausible remaining defects, but the durable fix affects config compatibility, persisted session keys, and direct-DM retention behavior.

options.title: Split scoped fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open and split implementation into account-scoped Feishu identity, malformed-id repair, and direct-DM retention work with explicit migration proof.

options.title: Account-scope only
options.body: Treat `per-account-channel-peer` as the supported fix and close only after docs or doctor make that path non-destructive for existing Feishu users.

options.title: Retention-only first
options.body: Fix maintenance pruning first and defer malformed-id or multi-app scoping to related Feishu identity work.

recommendation.title: Split scoped fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and split implementation into account-scoped Feishu identity, malformed-id repair, and direct-DM retention work with explicit migration proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest sampled history across session maintenance and the current session/Feishu surfaces that need a compatibility decision.
